meta.title: 10秒学会数字拍照法‼️（睡衣跟练版）
meta.title_en: Learn the Number Photo Method in 10 Seconds (Pajama Version)
meta.topic: 拍照教学 · 数字姿势

scenes.context: 数字拍照法：1到9每个数字一个动作。数字1：微笑看镜头，开场表情要自然。语域：拍照教学，动作口令。
sentences: Number one: smile at the lens.
smile at the lens（微笑看镜头）
The opening expression should look natural.
the simplest move（最简单的动作）
paraphrase: 看镜头 → look at the lens / face the camera
表情自然 → look natural / easy expression
scenes.speak: Number one: smile at the lens. The opening expression should look natural. Start with the simplest move.

scenes.context: 数字2-3：撩头发、歪头托腮，俏皮有动态。数字拍照法靠动作幅度区分。语域：拍照教学，动作口令。
sentences: Numbers two to three: brush the hair, tilt the head, rest on the chin.
brush the hair（撩头发）；tilt the head（歪头）
每个数字换个动作，连贯成一组。
Change the move per number and string them into a set.
string them into a set（连贯成组）
paraphrase: 撩发 → brush the hair / tuck the hair
托腮 → rest on the chin / chin on hand
scenes.speak: Numbers two to three: brush the hair, tilt the head, rest on the chin. Playful and full of motion. Change the move per number and string them into a set.

scenes.title_cn: 数字4-7：比耶叉腰、低头回眸
scenes.context: 数字4-5：比耶举手、叉腰侧身，活泼显瘦。数字6-7：低头笑、侧身回眸，温柔氛围大片感。语域：拍照教学，动作口令。
sentences: 数字4-5：比耶举手、叉腰侧身。
Numbers four to five: peace sign up, hip-hand side pose.
Numbers six to seven: head-down smile, glance back sideways.
paraphrase: 回眸 → glance back / look over the shoulder
scenes.speak: Numbers four to five: peace sign up, hip-hand side pose. Numbers six to seven: head-down smile, glance back sideways. Gentle vibes, a cinematic feel.

scenes.context: 数字8：遮脸或手部动作，神秘故事感。数字9：放松自然站，收尾不摆拍。十个数字十个姿势，跟练即会。语域：拍照教学，收尾。
sentences: 数字8：遮脸或手部动作，神秘故事感。
Number eight: cover the face or play with your hands — a mysterious, story-driven feel.
Number nine: stand relaxed and natural.
paraphrase: 遮脸 → cover the face / hand over the face
不摆拍 → without posing / no forced pose
scenes.speak: Number eight: cover the face or play with your hands — a mysterious, story-driven feel. Number nine: stand relaxed and natural. End it without posing.

practice: Number one: smile at the lens.
Numbers two to three: brush the hair, tilt the head.
Numbers four to seven: peace signs, hip-hands, head-down smiles.
Number eight covers the face; number nine stands relaxed.
pitfalls: Number one: smile at the lens.
「数字1：微笑看镜头」用 number one: smile at the lens。
Brush hair and rest the face.
Brush the hair, tilt the head, rest on the chin.
「歪头托腮」用 tilt the head, rest on the chin。
Peace sign up with a hip-hand side pose.
shifts: 用 smile at the lens（微笑看镜头）、brush the hair（撩发）、hip-hand（叉腰）
用 cinematic feel（大片感）、story-driven（故事感）、gentle vibes（温柔氛围）
用 string them into a set（连贯成组）、motion（动态）、no forced pose（不摆拍）
footer_notes: ASR 已校正：数字1-9、微笑看镜头、撩头发、歪头托腮、比耶举手、叉腰侧身、低头笑、侧身回眸、遮脸、放松自然站、不摆拍等。
